item.title: I had a hard night and barely slept. Sorry for the long post.
item.description:
I don't care who reads. This post is for me to scream into the void. I just can't stop thinking how fucked up this all is that my marriage is over when I had so much joy and hope for us and because of his lies and betrayals I had to turn into a woman I never thought I would be in order to escape him and afford to leave so I could restart my life back in the states.
3 FUCKING YEARS. I WASTED 3 YEARS OF MY LIFE ON HIM. Years I could have spent staying at a job I liked making money, saving, building friendships, keeping my casita, keeping my CAR, keeping my sanity and confidence! Not having to do OF to make money back to escape him cause I left my whole life behind to marry him and move to France!
I would always make some shuffling noise when walking just to alert him incase he was looking and downloading stuff I didn't want to see and would hear him click off his computer all the time when he'd hear me cause he was hiding things. I even walked in on him emailing a woman in another country who had no idea he even married me and when I confronted him he raged and grabbed my head and shouted "I'M FED UP! I'M FED UP!" Because I kept confronting him about hiding things I keep walking in on and that was the last straw that made me realize I needed to fucking get it all out and leave! That's when our shit hit the fan. He was "FED UP" that I was confronting him about shit he was doing behind my back! FUCK YOU!!!!
How do you lie to someone over and over with a smile and "loving eyes" knowing you are being a lying piece of shit wasting the life of a woman who has multiple chronic health problems and left her life to be with you in another country? How do yoy waste ANYONES TIME like that and not care to continue wasting their time???
The thought of even going back just triggers and traumatizes me. There is no way I could have been happy with a liar. The grass was not greener with him. It was so easy to keep me. I showed up to your country, at your door, and you couldn't even appreciate me. You stayed in your shitty creepy habits and wasted the best thing that ever happened to you. I was there and you took me for granted. I worked harder than any woman should for a liar and you still took me for granted time after time.
I don't think there is anything good coming my way. My life has been a series of unfortunate events starting with my terrible family, then my chronic health issues, this fucked up marriage, now what. Everything is getting more expensive. I can barely afford a place of my own. I sold most of what I owned to be with my husband. I broke and burned bridges with my old job and people who were excited for my new path in life to be married. I am not getting any younger, the cost of living is not getting any better, I will have no retirement or social security cause I've only worked 1099 jobs. My medicine is expensive and I am running out with no insurance. There is no hope. Just getting through each day. But I want my days to end sometimes. It is so scary. I am so scared for my future.
Missing someone who destroyed you is one of the hardest things to overcome and heal from. I want to stop loving and hating so much this man. I want to erase my memories and go back in time where I never knew he existed and never left my life behind to be with him. I have things I sometime feel like sharing with them but then I realize how much I fucking hate they guts and want to puke from all the trauma and pain and betrayals and lies and I realize over and over again how they literally were just a portrayal of a man they wished they could be, and these are words he even literally said to me. He was portraying a man online and in person he wanted to be. A "Superman" and "Angel" while stockpiling, saving, downloading thousands of images of women behind my back on multiple terabyte harddrives he hid IN OUR BEDROOM and waiting for me to sleep or go to the bathroom or on walks or leave to work in my country to do paperwork and my job at the time to make us money while he kept doing creepy downloads of unsuspecting women many he befriended on here or would talk trash about to make me feel like he had no interest in them. He lied about who he was emailing and DM'ing behind my back and discussing personal private matters even about me to some other women while lying to my face he wasn't doing anything. There is so much more I will never be able to fully list out like blaming a saved bloody tissue on his dead sister while in the next breath admitting it was something he saved from an EX in his nightstand. WHAT THE FUCK. I JUST CAN'T STOP THINKING ABOUT ALL THE SHIT. CAN SOMEONE JUST PLEASE SMASH MY BRAIN WITH A SLEDGE HAMMER!!! It's no wonder he always had ED cause he was so consumed with sexualizing EVERY WOMAN looking up and fantasizing in his brain every woman whether online, on the street when we were out I would see him just stare and look elsewhere when I would talk to him, women on TV even YOUNG actresses who he would fantasize how they would be when they grow up. Spending HOURS looking into their upbringing, their history, their private lives, who they've dated, are married to, if they have facebooks, he would do soooooooo many countless women it is never ending every time we would watch something on TV he would look up almost every female actress even while sitting next to me. He had so many flags but was so perfect online and hid mostly well while I was with him cause he did most of his downloads and fantasizing and messaging while I was asleep or away somewhere. GOD I FUCKING HATE THIS MAN!!!!
This is for any man AND WOMAN. Anyone man or woman who is lying to their partners and not being the best version of themselves they can be, breaking promises, hiding things behind their partners back, etc, PLEASE LET YOUR PARTNER GO. PLEASE DON'T BE SELFISH AND LIE TO MAKE THEM STAY AND WASTE THEIR LIFE ON YOU. The consequences of your inadequacy affects EVERYONE. More than you know. Either be the potential you want to be/ lie to be, or let us fucking go! My husband once said to me he looks in the mirror and thinks, "What a waste," and it is one of the few truths he has ever spoken, and I wholeheartedly agree. What a fucking waste. Yet he still doesn't try to improve himself nor wants to cause he listens to his mom and family he has also disillusioned and who think he is such a golden prize of a man. Yes, a couch potato who lies and lives surrounded by mess, dust, and clutter who barely pays the bills that are already income adjusted, and betrayed his wife- yeah he is such a prize.

item.title: GovBrief Today #607
item.description: Donald Trump wants the man who brokers America's deportation deals in Africa to be his ambassador to Cameroon. Christian Ehrhardt runs the State Department's Office of Remigration. Cameroon signed on last December, agreeing to take up to 1,000 people who aren't from there, the same day the US approved nearly $400 million in health aid. He would return as ambassador to the embassy where he once ran security. The Supreme Court today let these deportations continue without meaningful notice. More than 25,000 people have been expelled so far. Cameroon's first flight left Louisiana in January with its passengers handcuffed and chained. In Yaoundé they were held in a government compound and told they could leave only if they agreed to go home. I've emailed 9,301 stories over 607 straight nights, free and without ads. item.title: Sensible Chuckle
item.description:
To tell you the truth i think satire might be dead, satire isnt a comedic discipline anymore its simply the state in which we exist.
Gotta be honest, as an outsider, hes far less scary than most of y'all. He also has a beautifully proportioned head.
My minds going two paths on this one, Homeland, and Transplant. Hes not disproving any "harmful" stereotypes from Transplant, hes smoking hot.
Oh how i wish this was satire...
Interesting thing about that name, the direct translation is "The lord" or "The leader". Sayed and it's various other spellings are names of great honour, typically reserved for those believed to descend directly from the prophet. The legendary Spanish knight El-Cid obviously wasnt a descendant of the prophet but he was gifted the name by the moorish troops he led into battle during his 10 year exile which he spent serving the muslim rulers of Zaragoza. Pity they picked that wanker Heston to play him.
